name: Jeiru Koga
source: Jeiru is a member of the LWC, and an expert gunsman. He is a loose person who likes to spend all his wages on gambling and alcohol, then ends up having to ask for his paycheck in advance, which causes him to get preached at by Roy. He immediately quickly aims for the newcomer Yuuri.
